reviewed_pending_products.product_name: Drinking Water (Purified) sold through vending machine
reviewed_pending_products.positive_article_evidence_to_obtain: Confirm applicable finished dispensing-water legal category, point-of-sale collection route, water treatment controls, applicable IS/standards, sampling location and marketing form.
reviewed_pending_products.named_article_non_transfer: Packaged drinking water metals and pesticide MRLs cannot be silently assigned to dispensed drinking water.
disambiguation_evidence: Confirm FSSR 2.10.9 and the actual dispensing/packaging condition, water quality criteria, legal contaminant standard and sampling.

reviewed_pending_products.positive_article_evidence_to_obtain: Obtain exact coffee:chicory ratio, whether roasted coffee beans or chicory were processed into extract/powder, marketed finished form and matching statutory source article.
reviewed_pending_products.named_article_non_transfer: Copper article for coffee beans or dried chicory and ochratoxin A article for coffee cannot transfer to the mixture by label alone.
disambiguation_evidence: Verify actual coffee-to-chicory proportion, product standard 2.10.4, finished-form contaminant article and test basis.

reviewed_pending_products.positive_article_evidence_to_obtain: Document intended population and age, composition, infant-food statutory status, product form and relevant special nutrition regulations.
reviewed_pending_products.named_article_non_transfer: Infant formula lead/aflatoxin-M1 and infant milk substitute provisions cannot apply solely because children consume it.
disambiguation_evidence: Verify target age, full ingredient formula, special regulation and finished form

reviewed_pending_products.positive_article_evidence_to_obtain: Document each botanical fruit, peeled/cut/blanched/individually frozen processing, any additional ingredients and frozen market form; establish finished regulatory article.
reviewed_pending_products.named_article_non_transfer: Raw whole fruit, fruit juice and canned-fruit metal or pesticide articles require separate applicability evidence.
disambiguation_evidence: Establish each actual fruit/vegetable commodity, processing treatment, composition, regulatory pesticide scope and an authorized processing factor before computing any finished-product residue conclusion.

reviewed_pending_products.positive_article_evidence_to_obtain: Confirm botanical source, extraction/purification, powder or paste form and exact finished FSSR 2.11.2 commodity/matrix.
reviewed_pending_products.named_article_non_transfer: No automatic attribution from food colouring, dried herbs, spices, or generally undefined chemicals.
disambiguation_evidence: Identify botanical source, extraction, food grade and specified catechu product article

reviewed_pending_products.positive_article_evidence_to_obtain: Verify finished product gel structure, permitted FSSR fruit-cheese formulation and marketing identity; obtain legal basis if claiming the jam/pulp contaminant article.
reviewed_pending_products.named_article_non_transfer: Jam/jelly lead, fruit pulp copper/arsenic and canned-pulp tin cannot be borrowed by similarity.
disambiguation_evidence: prove the as-sold cooked paste/cheese/toffee is legally a fruit-pulp product, not simply made using a fruit input
finished formulation and heat/solids/water content plus concentration factor
CTR legal article scope, method, sample preparation and other contaminants

reviewed_pending_products.positive_article_evidence_to_obtain: Establish removal/drying/preservation processing, whole tamarind versus paste and any added preservatives before choosing exact finished article.
reviewed_pending_products.named_article_non_transfer: Fresh fruit or generic fruit-pulp metal limits and raw-commodity pesticide MRLs do not transfer automatically.
disambiguation_evidence: Confirm exact finished product (fruit pulp, fruit bar, preserve, candied peel, raw/dried fruit or mixed confection), the source article's processing scope and product-specific analytical matrix.

reviewed_pending_products.positive_article_evidence_to_obtain: Document actual coconut extract process, moisture/fat basis, additives and whether product is standardized coconut milk powder.
reviewed_pending_products.named_article_non_transfer: Aflatoxin M1 dairy milk powder rows, lead milk article and coconut oil metals cannot be copied over.
disambiguation_evidence: Determine the specific coconut product standard, processing and finished physical state; obtain a directly applicable coconut/non-dairy article before any numerical result.

reviewed_pending_products.positive_article_evidence_to_obtain: Verify true frozen product identity, source vegetables, recipe, blanching and any composite ingredients; retain separate finished-product scope.
reviewed_pending_products.named_article_non_transfer: Lead canned-vegetable and dried/dehydrated vegetables articles are not general frozen-vegetable limits.
disambiguation_evidence: Document the precise finished vegetable or processed matrix, moisture/process, any named finished-article source and the analytical sample basis.

reviewed_pending_products.positive_article_evidence_to_obtain: Check raw/roasted bean identity, shell status and stage at sale; establish any bean-specific official row and analytical basis.
reviewed_pending_products.named_article_non_transfer: Lead cocoa powder on dry fat-free substance basis and powder copper/arsenic cannot be assigned to beans.
disambiguation_evidence: Confirm whether the final tested food is cocoa powder, cocoa liquor, cake, beans or mixture and document the legally prescribed dry fat-free substance analytical basis.

reviewed_pending_products.product_name: Dry Mixtures of Cocoa and Sugars
reviewed_pending_products.positive_article_evidence_to_obtain: Verify actual standardized dry-mixture ingredients, cocoa solids/fat basis, product stage, and the finished article wording in CTR.
reviewed_pending_products.named_article_non_transfer: Cocoa powder metal values, high-ash sugar lead and HBC metal limits cannot be inherited automatically.
disambiguation_evidence: Confirm whether the final tested food is cocoa powder, cocoa liquor, cake, beans or mixture and document the legally prescribed dry fat-free substance analytical basis.

reviewed_pending_products.product_name: Cocoa mass or Cocoa/Chocolate Liquor and Cocoa Cake
reviewed_pending_products.positive_article_evidence_to_obtain: Obtain exact cocoa liquor/cake processing stage, fat content, defatting and sale identity; confirm article-specific fat-free analytical basis before matching.
reviewed_pending_products.named_article_non_transfer: Do not substitute cocoa-powder lead/copper analytical basis for high-fat cocoa mass or intermediate cake.
disambiguation_evidence: Confirm whether the final tested food is cocoa powder, cocoa liquor, cake, beans or mixture and document the legally prescribed dry fat-free substance analytical basis.

reviewed_pending_products.positive_article_evidence_to_obtain: Identify quinoa as sold, cleaned/hulled/flaked processing and its legal category; confirm each proposed CTR row individually.
reviewed_pending_products.named_article_non_transfer: The lead and cadmium cereal-grain row explicitly excluding quinoa cannot be transferred from wheat/rice.
disambiguation_evidence: Document botanical species, whole/kernel/flour identity, exact milled-food-grains MRL scope, transformation or processing factor, analytical sample basis and applicable amendments.

reviewed_pending_products.positive_article_evidence_to_obtain: Verify Salvia hispanica identity, processing, sale as edible whole chia or extraction feedstock and exact named oilseed article applicability.
reviewed_pending_products.named_article_non_transfer: Do not borrow unrelated cereal metal limits or unspecified oilseed/pesticide commodity MRLs.
disambiguation_evidence: Document botanical species, whole/kernel/flour identity, exact milled-food-grains MRL scope, transformation or processing factor, analytical sample basis and applicable amendments.

reviewed_pending_products.positive_article_evidence_to_obtain: Verify Ceratonia siliqua origin, drying/milling, powder composition and legal classification under FSSR 2.11.7.
reviewed_pending_products.named_article_non_transfer: Cocoa powder lead and copper limits, cocoa mass rules and generic coffee rules are not carob rules.
disambiguation_evidence: Verify Ceratonia siliqua plant source and FSSR 2.11.7 identity; do not inherit cocoa-powder lead/copper

reviewed_pending_products.positive_article_evidence_to_obtain: Confirm Maranta arundinacea or other source, refined starch versus milled root and actual standard 2.4.14 identity.
reviewed_pending_products.named_article_non_transfer: Hydrocyanic acid article expressly listing sago, cassava, tapioca and manihot does not list arrowroot.
disambiguation_evidence: Document botanical species, whole/kernel/flour identity, exact milled-food-grains MRL scope, transformation or processing factor, analytical sample basis and applicable amendments.

reviewed_pending_products.positive_article_evidence_to_obtain: Confirm Trapa species, processing, whole seed/milled flour basis and the specific standardized water-chestnut clause.
reviewed_pending_products.named_article_non_transfer: Do not inherit cassava/tapioca HCN provision or pesticide MRLs for milled cereal grains without source equivalence.
disambiguation_evidence: Document botanical species, whole/kernel/flour identity, exact milled-food-grains MRL scope, transformation or processing factor, analytical sample basis and applicable amendments.

reviewed_pending_products.positive_article_evidence_to_obtain: Document species, intestinal tissue, cleaned/salted/dried process, intended use and edible veterinary-residue basis.
reviewed_pending_products.named_article_non_transfer: Raw muscle/tissue veterinary MRLs and meat heavy-metal values cannot automatically be used for processed casings.
disambiguation_evidence: Identify source animal species, intestine/collagen tissue, processing and residue/sample matrix

reviewed_pending_products.positive_article_evidence_to_obtain: Confirm species, whole/yolk/white egg ingredient, shell removal, drying/concentration factor and edible finished powder basis.
reviewed_pending_products.named_article_non_transfer: Raw egg veterinary tolerance and fresh egg commodity MRLs cannot transfer without explicit processed-egg applicability.
disambiguation_evidence: Exact animal source, egg portion, product processing, residue definition, correct legally applicable processing or concentration factor and laboratory sample basis.

reviewed_pending_products.positive_article_evidence_to_obtain: Document egg species, shell removal, pickle medium, acidification process, moisture and final edible matrix.
reviewed_pending_products.named_article_non_transfer: Raw eggs residue and unprocessed animal product rules require named processed-pickled egg legal basis.
disambiguation_evidence: Exact animal source, egg portion, product processing, residue definition, correct legally applicable processing or concentration factor and laboratory sample basis.

reviewed_pending_products.positive_article_evidence_to_obtain: Verify the legal dried-glucose-syrup standard, actual sulphated ash method and exact marketed powder.
reviewed_pending_products.named_article_non_transfer: Lead row expressly requiring starch conversion products with sulphated ash over 1% is not met by compliant dried glucose syrup.
disambiguation_evidence: Specific finished sugar/syrup identity and documented laboratory sulphated ash % together with other legal article conditions.

reviewed_pending_products.positive_article_evidence_to_obtain: Establish lactose purity/crystal form and edible lactose 2.1.20 category; examine whether any lactose-specific metal article exists.
reviewed_pending_products.named_article_non_transfer: Lead for liquid milk and milk powder aflatoxin M1 criteria cannot transfer to purified lactose.
disambiguation_evidence: Authenticate actual finished milk or nonmilk identity, concentration ratio where required, ingredients and current operative standard; do not transfer a raw milk limit to a mixed recipe.

reviewed_pending_products.positive_article_evidence_to_obtain: Document true FSSR cube sugar 2.8.1(5) identity, sulphated versus total ash analytical basis and whether any specific refined-sugar article applies.
reviewed_pending_products.named_article_non_transfer: The high-sulphated-ash greater-than-1% lead article is not supported by this cube sugar standard.
disambiguation_evidence: Specific finished sugar/syrup identity and documented laboratory sulphated ash % together with other legal article conditions.

reviewed_pending_products.positive_article_evidence_to_obtain: Document FSSR 2.8.2 misri identity, raw sugar source, total ash and any sulphated ash result where legally relevant.
reviewed_pending_products.named_article_non_transfer: Do not treat total ash max 0.4% as a sulphated-ash greater-than-1% trigger or Misri as refined sugar by analogy.
disambiguation_evidence: Specific finished sugar/syrup identity and documented laboratory sulphated ash % together with other legal article conditions.

reviewed_pending_products.product_name: Polyols permitted under Appendix-A of FSS(FPS&FA) Regulations,2011 excluding those already standardized
reviewed_pending_products.positive_article_evidence_to_obtain: Identify exact molecular compound, purity/grade, CAS where applicable and any chemical-specific FSSAI metal article.
reviewed_pending_products.named_article_non_transfer: Sorbitol or other named polyol metal entries cannot apply to all unspecified polyols.
disambiguation_evidence: Identify individual polyol INS identity, chemical grade, preparation and specific purity article

reviewed_pending_products.positive_article_evidence_to_obtain: Get precise potassium/sodium/magnesium composition, regulated market category and specific constituent contaminant article.
reviewed_pending_products.named_article_non_transfer: Food-grade salt lead and iron-fortified common salt rows cannot be applied by name resemblance.
disambiguation_evidence: Identify potassium, magnesium, sodium fractions and composite salt-substitute article

reviewed_pending_products.positive_article_evidence_to_obtain: Establish material extraction process, whether it is a food ingredient or legal colour additive, concentration/dry colouring basis and FSSR identity.
reviewed_pending_products.named_article_non_transfer: Synthetic food colour or colouring matter lead/copper/arsenic rows require matching regulated colour class.
disambiguation_evidence: Identify actual plant extract, chemical colouring material, extraction process and applicability of any dry colouring matter testing basis

reviewed_pending_products.positive_article_evidence_to_obtain: Confirm trehalose 3.3.4 manufacturing/purity and the explicitly named food ingredient metal article, if any.
reviewed_pending_products.named_article_non_transfer: No unverified transfer from refined sugar, anhydrous dextrose or high-ash syrup rows.
disambiguation_evidence: Identify chemical trehalose form, standard 3.3.4, measured sulphated ash and actual named lead article

reviewed_pending_products.positive_article_evidence_to_obtain: Identify ingredient mineral/alkali composition, food-use status, purity source and specific FSSAI contaminant article.
reviewed_pending_products.named_article_non_transfer: Pure sodium hydroxide, sodium carbonate or regular salt articles are not automatically the mixed Sajji Khar article.
disambiguation_evidence: Establish traditional alkali source, major constituents, preparation and separate purity standard

reviewed_pending_products.product_name: Additives permitted under Appendix-A of FSS (FPS&FA) Regulations, 2011 and other food safety standards regulations excluding those already standardized and additives of Nutraceutical Regulations
reviewed_pending_products.positive_article_evidence_to_obtain: Select the precise permitted additive, standardized definition and corresponding individual CTR/FSSR limit, not the category umbrella.
reviewed_pending_products.named_article_non_transfer: Specific food dye, gum, preservative or antioxidant metal limits are not transferable to all additives.
disambiguation_evidence: Identify INS/CAS number, individual additive monograph, grade, concentration and use

reviewed_pending_products.product_name: Additives VA-VF of Nutraceutical Regulations excluding those already standardised
reviewed_pending_products.positive_article_evidence_to_obtain: Record exact authorized nutraceutical additive, intended use, standard and the applicable substance-specific source row.
reviewed_pending_products.named_article_non_transfer: An additive grouping does not establish the impurity specifications for an unspecified additive.
disambiguation_evidence: Identify legal schedule entry, ingredient chemical form and finished use

reviewed_pending_products.product_name: Permitted enzymes and their preparations excluding those already listed under Processing Aids and Nutraceutical Regulations
reviewed_pending_products.positive_article_evidence_to_obtain: Capture enzyme designation, microorganism/animal/plant source, processing-aid regulatory route and carrier formulation.
reviewed_pending_products.named_article_non_transfer: Enzyme preparations cannot automatically inherit metals for unrelated stabilizers, animal tissues or botanical raw materials.
disambiguation_evidence: Identify enzyme EC number, microorganism origin, formulation, processing aid and purification route

reviewed_pending_products.product_name: Ingredients listed under Schedule IV, Schedule VI and Schedule VIII of Nutraceutical Regulations
reviewed_pending_products.positive_article_evidence_to_obtain: Establish Schedule IV/VI/VIII item, botanical or chemical identity, extract ratio and source-specific legal limits.
reviewed_pending_products.named_article_non_transfer: No universal herb/spice/pulse MRL may be assigned to the entire regulatory schedule category.
disambiguation_evidence: Identify the exact Schedule IV, VI or VIII entry and substance, grade and composition

reviewed_pending_products.positive_article_evidence_to_obtain: Document actual formula, product claim and intended use, ingredient-specific legal articles, finished composite regulatory category.
reviewed_pending_products.named_article_non_transfer: An arbitrary parent functional ingredient MRL cannot stand in for the finished premix legal limit.
disambiguation_evidence: Identify entire ingredient recipe, concentrations, function, carrier and operative schedules

reviewed_pending_products.product_name: Cow or Buffalo Colostrum and Colostrum Products
reviewed_pending_products.positive_article_evidence_to_obtain: Confirm cow/buffalo colostrum versus concentrated/powder product, FSSR 2.1.23, IgG method and finished matrix before selecting contaminant articles.
reviewed_pending_products.named_article_non_transfer: Milk liquid lead or aflatoxin M1 milk powder article cannot transfer to colostrum without exact legal basis.
disambiguation_evidence: Authenticate actual finished milk or nonmilk identity, concentration ratio where required, ingredients and current operative standard; do not transfer a raw milk limit to a mixed recipe.

reviewed_pending_products.positive_article_evidence_to_obtain: Verify fresh/freeze-dried royal jelly identity, processing and source-specific CTR article; identify analytical basis.
reviewed_pending_products.named_article_non_transfer: Honey quality/contaminant values and beeswax lead article cannot be used for royal jelly.
disambiguation_evidence: Verify royal-jelly standard 2.8.3(3), bee-derived subtype and manufacturing form

reviewed_pending_products.positive_article_evidence_to_obtain: Establish lawful FSSR 2.11.4 silver purity and manufacturing requirements, alternative metal contamination criteria and applicable analytical method.
reviewed_pending_products.named_article_non_transfer: Food colour limits, metallic silver percentage, lead-in-food fallback and food contact metals are distinct questions.
disambiguation_evidence: Find exact FSSR finished-product identity and directly applicable Version IX article, purity test, analytical measurement basis and current amendments.

reviewed_pending_products.positive_article_evidence_to_obtain: Obtain official Ayurveda Aahara recipe, actual coconut and milk ingredients, processing, finished moisture and legal category.
reviewed_pending_products.named_article_non_transfer: Liquid milk lead/aflatoxin M1 and coconut oil metals cannot be inherited merely from ingredient names.
disambiguation_evidence: Authenticate actual finished milk or nonmilk identity, concentration ratio where required, ingredients and current operative standard; do not transfer a raw milk limit to a mixed recipe.

reviewed_pending_products.positive_article_evidence_to_obtain: Document exact official Ayurveda recipe, dairy proportion and other ingredients, thermal concentration and marketed category.
reviewed_pending_products.named_article_non_transfer: Milk liquid, dried milk and cereal ingredient source rows need explicit finished-form evidence.
disambiguation_evidence: Authenticate actual finished milk or nonmilk identity, concentration ratio where required, ingredients and current operative standard; do not transfer a raw milk limit to a mixed recipe.

reviewed_pending_products.positive_article_evidence_to_obtain: Check resistant/soluble dextrin origin, 2.11.8 manufacture and purification, food additive/ingredient category and actual specification.
reviewed_pending_products.named_article_non_transfer: Wheat grain metal/pesticide rows and high-ash starch-conversion product articles cannot be copied without proof.
disambiguation_evidence: Verify starch source, hydrolysis method, degree of polymerisation and actual sulphated ash

use_rule: Only after finished food and specific applicable article screening. A fallback article is positive source evidence but not proof of applicability or a product approval.
